name: spike-ci-profile
//: The CI test-speed spike's measurement harness: a hosted run's job wall clock divided by category, the recorders a demonstration run carries, and the replay of recent pull requests against finer Nx keys. Its tests drive each command through its real entry point, with a stand-in `gh` at the process boundary.

options.command: uv run --no-project --quiet --with psutil==7.1.3 python -m unittest discover -s spike/ci-profile -p 'test_*.py'

test.//: Uncached: its runner journey compiles a cargo shim with the host's rustc and starts a real cargo, which no input of this project describes.
